title.narrative: Evaluating the feasibility and preliminary efficacy of a wireless vital sign monitor for newborns

description.narrative: The Neopenda team has developed an affordable wireless vital signs monitor, neoGuard, that continuously measures pulse rate, blood oxygen saturation, respiratory rate and temperature, providing nurses and clinicians with real-time alerts of patients in distress. From one central monitoring application, the neoGuard technology allows monitoring of up to 15 patients at a time and enables more responsive and effective management of sick newborns in resource-constrained health facilities with critical shortages in health staff.

activity-date.narrative: Project commenced on 1 July 2020 and ended on 31 May 2022.
